decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposal is considered acceptable, because of its design and appearance, would not, when taken with the previous appeal approval yet to be implemented, harm the appearance of the original house or the Cranford Village Conservation Area, and it would not be harmful to the living conditions of the neighbours and would be in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All new development), ENV.B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Cranford Village Conservation Area Supplementary Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 4 Avenue Crescent.
Condition : 7 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before (the use hereby permitted is commenced) or (before the building(s) is/are occupied) or (in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension, two storey part front extension, and single storey part rear extension to house.
